request: Investigate the hold-up on order ORD-1008.

steps.text: I'll pull the order details first to see fulfillment status, promised date, items, and the shipping warehouse.

I'll check inventory for SKU-303 at WH-DAL to see if the warehouse can fulfill that line item. 
I'll also check inventory for SKU-606 at WH-DAL for the same reason.
I'll search other warehouses for SKU-303 to see if any single site can cover the 10-unit shortfall.
I'll finalize the investigation with a report summarizing the confirmed stock shortfall, supporting evidence, and recommended actions to resolve it before the promised date.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1008 is on hold at WH-DAL due to a confirmed stock shortfall on SKU-303; SKU-606 has sufficient stock. Recommend transferring 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS and shipping available items now.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1008 for Woodgrove Clinic at WH-DAL, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, ship_by_date 2026-03-16, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17, items SKU-303 qty 30 and SKU-606 qty 100.
check_inventory: SKU-303 at WH-DAL on_hand 22, reserved 2, available 20 (ordered 30) -> shortfall 10.
check_inventory: SKU-606 at WH-DAL on_hand 250, reserved 0, available 250 (ordered 100).
find_alternative_stock: SKU-303 required_quantity 10; WH-BOS available 50, can_cover_required_quantity true (WH-ATL 6 false; WH-CHI 5 false).
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available stock of SKU-303 at WH-DAL (20 available vs 30 ordered), preventing complete fulfillment.
uncertainties: Whether a transfer from WH-BOS can arrive before the 2026-03-17 promised delivery date.
Customer preference for partial shipment versus waiting for complete order.

recommended_actions.details: Initiate an immediate transfer of 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL to cover the shortfall; evidence: find_alternative_stock shows WH-BOS available 50 and can_cover_required_quantity true, and check_inventory shows WH-DAL available 20 vs ordered 30.
From WH-DAL, ship now the 20 units of SKU-303 that are available and all 100 units of SKU-606; evidence: check_inventory shows SKU-303 available 20 and SKU-606 available 250 at WH-DAL.

Inform Woodgrove Clinic that 10 units of SKU-303 will follow in a separate shipment due to a stock shortfall at WH-DAL, and provide an updated ETA once the transfer is scheduled; evidence: get_order_details promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17 and check_inventory shows a 10-unit shortfall on SKU-303.

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL and ship available items now, notifying the customer about the split shipment and updated ETA for the remaining 10 units.
